_doc: 年度重心 (design/life-paths.md): where each person puts their days, year in, year out. Set once and kept until changed; nobody has to set it. Each month it adds a little: skills (per month), how well they get to know people (known_peers: villagers of about their age; known_village: anyone), the household's harvest (work) and craft income (income), both counted against what the person would do by default so a village left to its defaults reaps and earns what it did before, standing (reputation), weight off the mind (stress), needs, and how the parents feel about them (opinion_parents). The gates later read the skills: a road nobody trained for is not on the menu, or its odds are low. Nothing says what was lost. stage: child = 5-13, adult = 14 and up. conditions: as in events, on the person.

foci.name: 下田幫忙
foci.desc: 跟著大人下田，學種地，家裡多一雙手

foci.name: 在家幫忙
foci.desc: 帶弟妹、做家務、餵雞，爹娘看在眼裡

foci.name: 去作坊跑腿
foci.desc: 在村裡的師傅那裡打雜，看會了一點手藝

foci.name: 跟神父認字
foci.desc: 天天去教堂跟神父念書（要先拜過神父）

foci.name: 跟孩子們玩
foci.desc: 在村裡跑來跑去，跟同年紀的孩子混熟

foci.name: 田裡
foci.desc: 把力氣都花在地裡，收成好一點

foci.name: 手藝
foci.desc: 把手藝練精，做出來的東西賣得好

foci.name: 交際
foci.desc: 上酒館、串門子、幫人忙，村裡人人都認得

foci.name: 教會
foci.desc: 常上教堂，幫神父做事，心裡踏實

foci.name: 養身
foci.desc: 不逞強，吃好睡好，少操心
